scope: Paired development diagnostic, not a scratch convergence claim.
control: Completed depth-h512-lambda1-minibatches4: final21/48, retention10/21; next-rollout critic explained variance approximately0.08-0.26.
hypothesis: After reducing the number of minibatches, critic fitting may be insufficient for the high-variance long-return targets. Extra value regression steps could improve subsequent on-policy value predictions and preserve behavior without increasing actor optimization.
intervention: Multiply existing separate critic fits by8:128 critic optimizer steps per rollout instead of16. Actor remains16 configured steps,4 epochs,4 minibatches.
held_fixed: Same complete source state, distance curriculum, horizon512 lambda1 gamma1 reward actor/critic learning rates target computation PPO clipping and update compilation. No stratified reset change is retained.
source_reuse: Completed minibatches4 source identity, likelihood, recurrence and fixed48 replay are reused. No extra source evaluation or model hash.
runtime_check: Assert the actual Optax critic step counter advances128 on every update. Report next-rollout critic explained variance/RMSE, not only fitted loss.
promotion: At actual final312 require at least17/21 original successes retained. Record every check and newly successful cases. No peak substitution.
refutation: If next-rollout value quality improves but retention still fails, insufficient regression alone is not a sufficient explanation. Lower fitted loss without behavioral retention is not a positive result.
reference_scope: Official PPO implementation controls policy and value gradient steps separately. It does not establish the proposed benefit in this drone task.
